svg.title: Governed Browser Policy and privacy-minimized Browser Activity
svg.desc: A versioned Browser Policy permits one governed Desktop browser surface using HTTPS origin, host match, path prefix, redirect behavior, and start rule. Only top-level open, close, allowed navigation or redirect, and blocked navigation events enter a minimization boundary. Retained fields include source and sequence, policy Revision, time, closed reason, and a minimized network location. Queries, fragments, credentials, page content, titles, referrers, headers, cookies, DOM data, download bodies, local paths, screenshots, clipboard, terminal output, and source code are excluded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Policy governs navigation; minimization governs evidence

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Browser Activity is not page capture, general history, or a verdict.
